description_en: Retrieve session analysis results. You can retrieve results in batches by specifying a list of session IDs or a time range
description_zh: 获取会话分析结果。可批量获取，根据会话ID列表或时间范围
kebab_example: aliyun dianjin get-dialog-analysis-result --workspace-id llm-xxxx --session-ids 183764873624 --use-url true --start-time 2024-09-14_09:11:00 --end-time 2024-09-23_09:20:02 --asc true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDialogAnalysisResult

parameters.help_en: Session ID list. When useUrl is true, the response includes OSS URLs. You can specify up to 1000 sessions. If you specify more than 1000, only the first 1000 are processed. When useUrl is false, the response includes full analysis results. You can specify up to 10 sessions. If you specify more than 10, only the first 10 are processed. This parameter is optional. If sessionIds is empty, the API retrieves results for sessions created between startTime and endTime. If sessionIds is not empty, the API retrieves results for the specified sessions. You cannot leave both sessionIds and the time range empty
parameters.help_zh: 会话id列表。useUrl为true时，返回ossUrl；支持1000个会话，超过1000个，返回前1000个会话的分析结果。useUrl为false时，返回会话分析结果；仅支持10个会话，超过10个，返回前10个会话的分析结果。非必填。sessionIds为空时根据起始时间和结束时间查询会话分析结果。不为空时，根据sessionIds查询会话分析结果。二者不可同时为空
parameters.name: session_ids

parameters.help_en: Whether to return an OSS URL instead of full analysis results. If true, the response includes an OSS URL that expires in one hour. Default is true. Supports up to 1000 sessions. If you specify more than 1000, only the first 1000 are processed. If false, the response includes full analysis results. Supports up to 10 sessions. If you specify more than 10, only the first 10 are processed
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果是否为ossUrl。为true时，返回结果ossUrl，链接有效期为1小时。默认为true；支持1000个会话，超过1000个，返回前1000个会话的分析结果。为false时，返回会话分析结果；仅支持10个会话，超过10个，返回前10个会话的分析结果
parameters.name: use_url

parameters.help_en: Start time in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If sessionIds is not empty, you can query the session analysis results using the specified session IDs
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间, 格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss。sessionIds不为空时，根据sessionIds查询会话分析结果
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time, which must be in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If sessionIds are provided, the system queries session analysis results based on these IDs
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间, 格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss。sessionIds不为空时，根据sessionIds查询会话分析结果
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Whether to sort in ascending order. Default is true, which sorts by session creation time in ascending order. If false, sorts in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 是否升序, 默认为true，按会话创建时间升序排序。为false时，按会话创建时间降序排序
parameters.name: asc
